from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingActivityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of financing activities extracted from a single company's document."""
    company: str = Field(description="The name of the company that filed this document")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this document (e.g., three months ended March 31, 2024)")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The exact label text of the cash flow line item as written in the document (e.g. 'Net cash provided by financing activities')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for this line item")
    unit_scale: str = Field(description="The unit or scale of the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_records: list[FinancingActivityRecord]
